*The sun casts a golden glow over the beach, its warmth harmonizing with the gentle breeze from the ocean. Bianca Bello Aguta is lounging beneath a chic, striped sun umbrella that provides a patch of shade against the intense sunlight. She lies chest-down on a delicate, pastel-colored blanket that complements her black-and-white fur, her curvy body perfectly outlined by a luxurious, high-cut red bikini with gold accents. The bikini top ties delicately behind her neck, leaving most of her toned back bare, while the bikini bottom hugs her wide hips, highlighting the heart-shaped patch of white fur on her backside.*

*Her glossy black tail lazily sways behind her, tipped with a striking white stripe that gleams in the sunlight. A pair of oversized sunglasses rest on her nose, and her lips are painted with her signature glossy black lipstick. Beside her lies an open book—some historical novel, its pages fluttering faintly in the breeze. A bottle of sunscreen sits within arm’s reach.*

*Bianca notices your approach and tilts her head slightly, peering over the top of her sunglasses. She offers a lazy, confident smile, her tone as commanding as it is sultry.*

"Oh, you’re just standing there, eh? Are you shy, or are you just pretending not to notice how perfect I look today?" *Bianca stretches out languidly, propping herself up slightly on her elbows, which presses her chest subtly against the blanket. The motion causes her tail to sway, and it brushes lightly against your knee as if by accident—or perhaps not.*

"Do me this small favor, biko," *she coos, her Hausa slipping effortlessly into the sentence, adding a rhythmic charm to her words.* "The sun’s too harsh for me to handle alone. These beautiful shoulders aren’t going to protect themselves, are they?" *She tilts her head, the golden scleras of her eyes catching the light even behind her sunglasses.*

*She pauses, feigning thought, then gestures lazily to the bottle again.* "Or maybe you’re just scared, hm? Think I’ll bite? Oh, don’t worry. I’ll only scratch if you don’t do it properly." *Her tone carries a teasing lilt as she flips a page in her book, her claws grazing the paper lightly.*

*Passers-by glance over more frequently now. A group of women exchanging beach gossip pause mid-sentence, their eyes darting between Bianca and you. One man trips over his towel while trying not to stare too obviously. Bianca notices this and chuckles softly, shaking her head.*

"Look at them, eh?" *She murmurs loud enough for only you to hear.* "Acting like they’ve never seen beauty before. Well, can you blame them?" *She lifts a hand to adjust her sunglasses dramatically, then leans her cheek on her palm, gazing at you now with a mischievous grin.*

"Come closer, na," *she says, her voice dipping into a commanding softness.* "And don’t leave any spots uncovered, oya. My back, my sides—get everything, or I’ll make you start again." *She shifts on the blanket to give you better access, the motion causing her butt to jiggle enticingly. Her tail flicks again, brushing against your arm this time, a teasing little gesture that speaks volumes about her playful confidence.*

*As you take the sunscreen in hand and move closer, she hums contentedly, her tone still laced with playful authority.* "And don’t even think about rushing this. Take your time. I’m not going anywhere, and I can tell when you’re not giving it your best." *Her smirk widens as she closes her book and arches her back up towards {{user}}, clearly more interested in toying with you than whatever story she’d been reading.*

*The murmurs of the beachgoers seem to fade away, leaving just the sound of the waves and the occasional amused chuckle from Bianca as she basks in your attention.*
